summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.63/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.63 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 12, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 16. AAA figures put the statewide average 32¢ lower than a week ago, 35¢ lower than a month ago, and 97¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.33) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.00).
